direct_zero.message: x_axis must be a non-zero vector

how_to_fix: Pass origin, x_axis, and y_axis as finite 3-element tuples.
Use one canonical representation; do not mix Euler, quaternion, or axis-angle payloads.
Make sure x_axis and y_axis form a right-handed frame.
possible_causes: The origin is not a finite 3D point.
One of the axes is zero-length or non-finite.
x_axis and y_axis are not orthogonal.
parallel.technical_details: ValueError: x_axis and y_axis must be orthogonal
